title: Ignore Unused Fields
goal: Extract the status code from a response while ignoring payload data.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Pattern Matching

hints: Rust requires struct patterns to mention all fields or explicitly ignore the rest.
The `..` operator ignores all remaining fields in a struct pattern.
explanation: `..` in a struct pattern tells the compiler to ignore all unmentioned fields. Writing `payload: _` ignores only the `payload` field, leaving `latency_ms` unmentioned and causing `E0027`. A plain wildcard `_` is invalid syntax inside a struct destructuring pattern.
